title: COSE decoders reject RFC 9052 tag-18 COSE_Sign1; vector corpora embed the tagged form
description: Found wiring test/vectors/root_dio_signature.json and capability_announcements.json (both embed cose_sign1 as RFC 9052 tag-18-tagged CBOR). Python RootDioSignature.from_cose_sign1 and decode_cose_sign1_announcement do cbor2.loads then require isinstance(list) of len 4 - a tag-18 CBORTag raises ValueError('COSE_Sign1 must be a 4-element array'). Every cross-impl consumer must unwrap tag 18 first (see _untagged_cose_sign1 helper in python/tests/crypto/test_orphan_vector_consumers.py). Decide one side: (a) accept both tagged and untagged forms in the decoders (RFC 9052 tags COSE_Sign1 when standalone), or (b) regenerate the vector corpora untagged and document the convention. C/Zephyr decoders should be audited for the same strictness.
